items.heading: These Are Broad Patterns, Not
items.text: These are broad patterns, not a claim that every provider in a category behaves identically, individual counsellors and platforms vary. Use the matrix to see which pattern typically shows up where, then check the specific service you are weighing against it.

items.heading: The Matrix Above Lists Pricing
items.text: The matrix above lists pricing transparency as one of the criteria worth checking on any service. Here is what that looks like concretely on this one, so you have real numbers to hold any other service against.
